tower.environments.v1alpha1.Blueprint.description: Blueprint is what a machine is: workstream's blueprint, carried whole, as blueprints are workstream's.

baseImage.description: The image the golden is converged from, such as "ubuntu-24.04".

content.description: The converge body (an ansible playbook). tower hashes it. Its golden phase is every task but those tagged configure; its configure phase, run in each machine with its own vars and secrets, is those tagged configure (docs/decisions/machine-blueprints.md).

exposePorts.description: Ports a box on the network reaches it at.

goldenVars.description: Variables of the golden phase, which are part of what the golden is.

netAlias.description: Its name on the workstream's network; empty is the machine's own name, as a box's is the box's. Another machine or box of the workstream that already answers to it refuses the machine.

readyCheck.description: What says the machine is ready, which its configure phase finishing does not: a service it starts may take a while to come up after (k3s reports its node Ready only after the playbook ends). workstream's blueprints declare one as readyCheck. None is ready once configured.

runAs.description: The user its phases and ready check run as; unset is root. It is the client's to name: tower names none of its own (docs/decisions/machine-blueprints.md). Part of what the golden is.

resources.description: Its size. A field left empty is tower's default as the machine is made, and the size it has after. Changed later, it resizes the machine: a running one restarts at the new size (its ready check runs again, its configure phase does not); a stopped one takes it and stays stopped. A disk only grows: a smaller one is refused, and the rest applied. A size the target has no room for is held, the machine keeping the size it has, and applied once there is room. Condition Resized says where it stands (docs/decisions/machine-resize.md).

runState.description: RunState is whether an environment should be running. Stopped keeps its disk.

secrets.description: The blueprint's required secrets, given in the configure phase only.

tailnet.description: Joins the machine to a tailnet as a node of its own, before its configure phase; never its golden. Changed on a live machine, it is applied to it, as a box's is, without a restart. Whether it joined is its TailnetJoined condition (docs/decisions/tailnet.md).

vars.description: This machine's own variables, given in its configure phase only; they never enter its golden.

tower.environments.v1alpha1.MachineStatu.description: MachineStatus is what tower reports about the machine.

address.description: Its address on the workstream's network.

conditions.description: Ready, with GoldenBuilt, Configured and Resized; and TailnetJoined, for a machine with spec.tailnet, as a box's (BoxStatus.conditions), which never holds the machine back from READY and goes with spec.tailnet.

phase.description:
MachinePhase is where a machine is in its life.

- MACHINE_PHASE_BUILDING: Its golden is being converged.
- MACHINE_PHASE_CONFIGURING: Cloned from its golden; its configure phase runs.

resources.description: The size its instance has as its target last reported it (InstanceStatus.resources); empty until reported. While it differs from spec.resources, a resize is under way, or held for want of room or refused, as condition Resized says.

startTime.description: When its instance last started, as tower last read it from its target: empty while the instance is stopped, and kept as it was while tower does not read the instance (while it waits for its target or makes the instance again). A restart, for a new size or otherwise, changes it.

tower.environments.v1alpha1.ReadyCheck.description: ReadyCheck is a shell command run in the machine after its configure phase, every 5 seconds until it exits 0. It is checked again after each start of the machine, since what it checks starts again with it.

command.description: Run as sh -c command, as the blueprint's run_as user (root if it has none), without the machine's secrets.

timeout.description: How long it may take to pass before the machine fails; unset is 200 seconds, as workstream allows (40 tries, 5 seconds apart).

tower.environments.v1alpha1.Resources.description: Resources is a shape, as quantities; an empty one takes tower's default.

disk.description: Such as "40Gi"; a disk only grows.

tower.environments.v1alpha1.RunAs.description: RunAs is the user a blueprint's playbook runs as, as a playbook written to be run over ssh by a user with passwordless sudo expects: tasks with become get root through sudo, the others and ~ are the user's. The machine's ready check, and what a client runs and writes in it through EnvironmentService, are the user's too.

user.description: A POSIX user name (lower case letters, digits, '_' and '-', starting with a letter or '_', at most 32), not root. tower makes the user in the golden's builder unless the base image has one of the name, and gives it a home directory and passwordless sudo.

tower.environments.v1alpha1.SecretRef.description: SecretRef names one value of a Secret and what to call it.

as.description: The variable the value is given as.

secret.description: A Secret in the same project.

tower.environments.v1alpha1.Tailnet.description: Tailnet joins a box or machine to a tailnet as a node of its own, the first time its instance starts; after that its node's state is kept with the instance and it comes back as the same node.

acceptRoutes.description: Accept the subnet routes the tailnet offers the node.

authSecret.description: A Secret in the same project holding, under "authkey", the key to join with. Its value never enters a spec of a lower layer, a status, a log or an event (docs/decisions/secrets.md).

hostname.description: The node's hostname on the tailnet.

tower.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

tower.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.tower.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.tower.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

tower.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

description: Machine is a VM an agent builds against, such as a k3s cluster: a blueprint converged on the project's target. tower never stops a machine for idleness, because what uses it (a box on the same network) does not pass through tower; it stops only when workstream asks.
title: Machine
